transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the weekly access-control review started. We've got the passkey rollout for the internal administrator console coming up on Monday at 09:00, and I need to go through the checklist with each of you before I can approve the production rollout plan. I'll be calling on the identity platform lead, IT operations lead, and compliance engineer individually. For each of you, I need to hear any rollout-impacting findings, the exact plan changes you require, and the follow-up you'll own. I won't approve the plan until each role has completed that check-in. Let's start with identity platform -- what findings do you have?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing an unrelated mobile-device enrollment issue this morning, I confirmed that 23 legacy mobile clients cannot complete the passkey ceremony. The identity platform team requires a 10% canary rollout and a 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement. I have not yet updated the rollout ticket with this finding.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: While preparing the weekly administrator access roster, I confirmed that 18 contractor accounts do not receive their required hardware keys until Wednesday at 09:00. IT Operations must exclude those accounts from enrollment until that time. I have not yet added the exception list to the rollout plan.

transcript.text: During a control-evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that privileged administrator authentication events must be kept in immutable storage for exactly 400 days. The current draft rollout plan only keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, which does not meet this requirement. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout. The exact plan change I require is that the rollout plan must specify immutable storage retention of privileged administrator authentication events for 400 days before I can approve from a compliance standpoint. I will own opening the compliance ticket and verifying the retention configuration is in place.
